Staff Vacancy
Monday, 01 February 2021
7227 Hits
Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites applications for the following posts. Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist Wardha 442 102 latest by
20th February 2021
. Candidate must have registration with local employment exchange, copy of the same must be submitted along with the application.
Accountant (2 – 1 SC, 1 OBC)
:
Qualification and Experience: Graduation in Commerce from recognized University in India or equivalent, proficiency in operating the computerized system and should have dealt with the maintenance of Books of Accounts like cash book, ledger, journal, stock-books and the process of scrutiny of bills and pay bills, drawing salaries, should have adequate knowledge about Income Tax Laws, Provident Fund, Professional Tax, etc. He/She should also have knowledge of preparing a budget, drawing the profit/ loss accounts, balance sheet, etc. with experience of 5 years or more in and organization having an annual turnover of Rs. 25 Crores and above.
Senior Clerk (2 – 1 SC, 1 OBC):
Qualification and Experience : Must be a graduate from any recognized University in India with 5 years’ experience of working in accounting in the Office of Medical College / Educational Institutions or in a large
hospital.
Pay Scale/ Salary
: As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for open category, between 18 to 43 years for reserved category
Note
: 1. Candidate with exceptional experience can be considered for relaxation in age limit by the selection committee
2. Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
